title: Intrinsic constructible inputs for mixed base change
statement: Fix a field k of characteristic p>0 and a prime ℓ≠p. Let X,Y,X′,Y′ and the compactification space Z be separated finite-type k-schemes, with k-morphisms h:X′→X, f′:X′→Y′, f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y forming a Cartesian square. Let c=(j:X→Z,q:Z→Y) be a compactification of f by k-morphisms. Let A be a finite commutative ring killed by a power of ℓ and let M be bounded intrinsically constructible of finite Tor amplitude on X. Then h_A^*M is bounded intrinsically constructible of finite Tor amplitude on X′, and the specified proper/open mixedCompactSupportExchange [def-sp-mixed-base-change-operations] at M is invertible. Smoothness of f and a coefficient change A→B are not needed for either conclusion.

source.place: Direct images: compactification formulas and legitimacy of constructible inputs; invertibility of beta (DAG Step 4)

proof.text: Finite-type schemes over a field are Noetherian. Pullback of the finite locally constant stratification preserves intrinsic constructibility; exact inverse image preserves the cohomological bounds, and its canonical tensor comparison preserves the Tor interval. This is the finite ordinary constant-ring specialization of constructible finite-Tor pullback stability.

Choose a bounded etale antecedent of M by finite-ring constructible derived origin. Extend it by zero and use the exact open-extension comparison. Proper base change makes the proper exchange at this extended object invertible. Its counit-mate normalization identifies it with directImageConstantExchange; the open factor is an isomorphism by construction. Hence the composite defining mixedCompactSupportExchange is invertible.

theorem mixedBaseChange_input
    (ℓ pchar : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hp : 0 < pchar) (hℓ : pchar ≠ ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k pchar]
    {X Y X' : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [X'.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X' ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (cpt : Compactification f) [cpt.Z.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (cpt.Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (cpt.Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (cpt.Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [cpt.i.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [cpt.g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    {Y' : Scheme.{u}} [Y'.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y' ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    [g'.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [f'.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0)
    (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) (hM : spFiniteConstructibleTor X A M) :
    spFiniteConstructibleTor X' A
        ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A g').obj M) ∧
      IsIso ((mixedCompactSupportExchange A sq cpt).app M)
